colors.name: Void Canvas
colors.role: Primary page background - the base layer for hero, sections, and footer. Slight cool-blue undertone, never pure black, so colored elements feel like they're floating in space rather than printed on paper

colors.name: Abyss
colors.role: Deeper surface level for elevated cards, code blocks, and inset wells. One step darker than the canvas to create depth without using shadows

colors.name: Singularity
colors.role: Darkest surface for terminal windows, CLI boxes, and high-contrast containers. Almost pure black with a blue whisper

colors.name: Carbon
colors.role: Mid-elevation card surface, sitting between canvas and abyss. Used for theme preview tiles and nested cards

colors.name: Lunar White
colors.role: Primary text and high-contrast foreground. The slightly cool tint keeps it from feeling clinical against the dark canvas

colors.name: Platinum
colors.role: Secondary text, icon strokes, and light dividers. Most-used achromatic token for hairline borders and muted foregrounds

colors.name: Mist
colors.role: Supporting neutral for secondary UI, dividers, and muted labels. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

colors.name: Steel
colors.role: Muted body text and subdued descriptions. The default for paragraphs that should recede behind headlines

colors.name: Gunmetal
colors.role: Hairline borders and dividers on the dark canvas. Low contrast on purpose - structural, not decorative

colors.name: Aurora Mint
colors.role: Teal supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis

colors.name: Plasma Blue
colors.role: Blue supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis

colors.name: Ultraviolet
colors.role: Code keywords, violet link variant, and decorative highlight. A desaturated violet that complements the nebula gradient without competing

colors.name: Electric Cyan
colors.role: Secondary syntax token - reserved for specific code contexts and rare accent strokes

colors.name: Amber
colors.role: Yellow supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis

colors.name: Signal Blue
colors.role: Decorative dot and badge accent - used for version pills and notification indicators

fonts.name: ui-sans-serif
fonts.role: Body and UI text - system stack fallback. Weight 400 for body copy, 500/600 for button labels and nav, 700 for subheadings. Line-height 1.65 at 14px keeps dense UI readable without feeling airy.

fonts.name: Obviously
fonts.role: Display and headline face - the custom workhorse. Weight 300/400 used for the largest headlines, 700 for the hero. The cv09 and salt alternates give it a distinctive wide, slightly retro character; ss06 and ss11 add quirky details. No web-safe substitute captures the feel - Inter Black or Space Grotesk Bold approximate it.

fonts.name: ui-monospace
fonts.role: Code blocks, terminal commands, and inline code. Fixed 14px with generous 1.65 line-height for readability of multi-line snippets.

fonts.name: MDIO
fonts.role: Icon and badge face - used at 12-16px with widened tracking (0.0250em) for small labels and version chips. The slight letter-spacing and geometric forms give badges a technical, instrument-panel feel.

fonts.name: Inter
fonts.role: Inter - detected in extracted data but not described by AI

components.name: Hero Gradient Backdrop
components.role: Atmospheric background glow behind hero content

components.name: Stats Bar
components.role: Performance metric display (e.g., '% of real-world sites with good Core Web Vitals')

do: Use 9999px radius for all interactive elements (buttons, tabs, badges, chips)
Set the primary CTA to white background (#ffffff) with dark text (#1f232e) - inversion is the system's signature action pattern
Use the nebula gradient (linear-gradient(83.21deg, #3245ff, #b845ed)) only for hero atmospheric backdrops and stat bars - never for buttons or cards
Set section eyebrows (14px weight 600) in chromatic accent colors (#4bf3c8, #acafff, #54b9ff) to create the only color punctuation in each section
Use Obviously at weight 300-400 for headlines to keep the voice whisper-confident rather than shouty
Maintain 4px base unit for all spacing - element gaps at 8px or 16px, section gaps at 80px
Place colored borders (1px) on circular icon containers in feature columns using Aurora Mint, Plasma Blue, or Amber
doNot: Don't use drop shadows for elevation - the system relies on 1px borders in slightly lighter dark shades
Don't apply the nebula gradient to text - it destroys legibility against the dark canvas
Don't use chromatic colors for large background fills - they break the cosmic void atmosphere
Don't use radius values between 12px and 16px on cards - the system snaps to 8px, 12px, or 16px
Don't set body text below 14px or above 18px - the type scale is tight to maintain the instrument-panel density
Don't use obviously > 700 for headlines - the weight 300-400 range is the signature restraint
Don't add decorative icons inside buttons - pills should be text-only or text + chevron
